interpretation.decision: retain native source-image crops, oracle visible-support masks and Lanczos as the default. The bounded visual and pixel audit gives no support for a filter change. No separate decoder/filter implementation is justified by this sample. Rectification remains an offline comparison only.
limits: The source video is already lossy; direct PNG decode removes only the additional JPEG encoding step.
A 24-item development sample is not representative and provides no classifier-quality evidence.
Generated pose proposals are not human-reviewed card-scene authority. High fit residual is a warning, not ground truth.
Filter occupancy is a pixel-occupancy measure, not useful-information coverage.

notes: JPEG is exact application resolver output; PNG is direct decode of same selected presentation frame.
Pixel error measured only inside reviewed visible support.
Filter outputs are native crop aspect-preserving Lanczos/BOX-area/bicubic resize to 224-square neutral letterbox.

failure_comparison.assessment: Rejected as an identity input: a narrow reviewed source strip and high residual do not validate a full-card pose. The warp stretches the strip into a card-shaped view. No hidden content is inferred.

rectification.orientation: The calibrated projection preserves the 180-degree ambiguity. It does not assign an identity orientation.

positive_comparison.pose_fit_status: accepted generated proposal; not a completed human-reviewed scene

sampling_policy.selection: Eight exact reviewed crops per eligible recording in the 0086 M2 detection-only handoff. IMG_0095 and IMG_0097 include lower and highest residual fitted pose proposals. IMG_0654 samples across time; its generated poses have no completed reviewed-scene authority.

timing_summary.note: Per-sample wall time for exact frame resolution; excludes the separate direct PNG decode and aggregate startup/probe work.
